notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (requests, desktop UA) for robots.txt, homepage locale-picker, and the /en-gb full site (mega-menu is server-rendered HTML). robots.txt disallows only specific paths (search-results-page, cart, checkout, and several other-locale path patterns like */gb/en/, */fi/fi) - none of it blocks /en-gb/ or a full-site crawl, and no Claude/anthropic-ai bot rule is present, so no tier restriction applied. Product-count numbers are injected client-side by a Coveo-powered listing widget after hydration (not present in raw SSR HTML, no usable embedded JSON/API), so tier (b) Playwright (headless chromium, networkidle wait) was used to read the rendered '<N> results' header on each leaf category page and confirm h1/canonical. No block encountered at any tier. TREE: built from the /en-gb mega-menu (Tableware, Home Decor, Collections, Gifts) plus /en-gb/sitemap.xml cross-check. The only textile-labelled branch is Home Decor > Textiles (interior-textiles), with exactly 3 leaf children: Home Textiles, Kitchen Textiles, Bathroom Textiles - confirmed as the full leaf set via sitemap product URLs grouped under each of the 3 category paths (no further sub-levels, no pagination beyond the single rendered page for any of the 3). No Storage/Organization/Basket/Shelving/Rack/Wardrobe node exists anywhere in the mega-menu, sitemap URL set, or Home Decor sub-strip (checked via keyword scan of both) - Iittala sells tableware, glassware, decorative objects, candles, lamps and these 3 textile subtypes only; storage_rows is empty for a real reason, not an oversight. QTY: exact 'N results' text rendered on each Coveo listing page after JS hydration, cross-verified by counting the distinct product-detail URLs listed under each category path in sitemap.xml (Home Textiles: 2 products both blankets, matches; Bathroom Textiles: 3 hand-towel colour variants, matches; Kitchen Textiles: 16 product URLs, matches). EXCLUDED: Tableware branch (plates/bowls/cutlery/drinkware/cookware/serveware) - Kitchen & Dining, not Textile/Storage. Home Decor > decorative-objects, vases-plant-pots, candles-and-candle-holders, lamps - Decorative Home Accessories/Lighting, not Textile/Storage. Collections (Aalto, Teema, Kastehelmi etc.) - cross-cutting design-line filters, not standalone product categories, and 'all-collections'/'all-iittala-products' are View-All aggregations - excluded per View-All/Collections rule. Gifts section (by-occasion/by-price/by-recipient) - promotional/gift landing pages, excluded. FLAG ON KITCHEN TEXTILES: of the 16 products under this node, sitemap product-name inspection shows 11 are paper napkins (Play/Taika/Iittala 'paper napkin' and 'napkins' lines - paper is not a textile material per rules Sec 16) and only 5 are genuine textile products (4 fabric table cloths + 1 linen tea towel). The website itself groups all 16 under its own 'Kitchen Textiles' navigation node (Home Decor > Textiles > Kitchen Textiles), so the site's exact category count (16) is reported per website-hierarchy rule rather than fabricating a filtered sub-count, but confidence is set to LOW and the row is flagged for manual review given the majority-paper composition.
